title: Sighting map clusters around Trinity Site

tellings.quote: the proximity to Trinity site was unbelievable

plain: When UFO sightings from the 1940s and 1950s are put on a map, they cluster around Trinity Site in New Mexico, where the first atomic bomb was tested, says the documentary filmmaker James Fox, who worked on this for his film The Phenomenon. Fox says "the proximity to Trinity site was unbelievable," and he credits the filmmaker Lance Mungia and the nuclear UFO researcher Robert Hastings in telling it. If true, it would suggest the phenomenon took a special interest in atomic weapons.
